globalRules.historicalPolicy: For historical_order_detail_only products (no current catalog row), classify PRODUCT_FAMILY from the order-line name only when the name alone is unambiguous. Never classify DISCIPLINE or USE_CONTEXT from a historical row unless the name itself carries explicit evidence. Missing metadata is unknown, not negative evidence. No automatic successor-to-current-catalog mapping.
